firm_data.firm_name: Law Offices of Robert S. Gitmeid & Associates, PLLC
firm_data.firm_description: The Law Offices of Robert S. Gitmeid & Associates, PLLC is a consumer-advocacy law firm based in New York City dedicated to providing legal representation to clients who face challenges from their creditors. They employ creative legal strategies and theories at the cutting edge of consumer law.
notable_facts: The firm was founded to address the growing need for legal expertise in debt relief and consumer advocacy following the 2008 financial crisis.
The firm offers free initial consultations and a contingency fee structure for certain services.

email.subject: AI for Law Offices of Robert S. Gitmeid & Associates, PLLC
email.body:
Hi Robert,

Your firm was founded to meet a real gap in consumer advocacy following 2008, and you've built a practice around cutting-edge legal strategies in debt relief and bankruptcy. That kind of innovation requires tools that actually understand consumer law.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
